content.text:
I implemented `parseCsvLine` in `src/csv.mjs`. I ran it on a few sample lines and each result matched the README rules. The repo has no test suite and no checks listed in `.claude/referee.json`, so I did not run any.

The sample lines covered:
- an empty line, which gives `['']`
- a plain `a,b`
- spaces outside quotes, which are kept
- a quoted field containing a comma
- an escaped `""` inside quotes, which becomes one literal quote
- a lone comma, which gives two empty fields
- an empty quoted field, which gives `['']`

The README doesn't say how to handle an unclosed quote or text after a closing quote. The code doesn't throw in those cases. An unclosed quote runs to the end of the line, and text after a closing quote is appended to the same field.
